# prime-tooltip

prime-rs: Tooltip directive (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/tooltip) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-tooltip) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/tooltip.md)

Tooltip: a port of the `pTooltip` directive from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

A tooltip for any element, attached with the Leptos `use:` directive; the element markup is not changed. The tooltip is shown on
mouse hover, touch or focus, picks a side and moves to another one when there is not enough room.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_tooltip::{TooltipOptions, TooltipPosition, tooltip};

let html = view! {
    <input use:tooltip=TooltipOptions::text("Enter your username").position(TooltipPosition::Top) placeholder="Top" />
}
.to_html();
// the directive works only in the browser: the server markup is not changed
assert!(!html.contains("tooltip") && html.contains("placeholder"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-tooltip = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["tooltip"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
